content.text: Sync agents that poll for recently changed issues currently approximate "since" with updated_at timestamps, which misses clock skew and double-delivers rows updated in the same second.

Add query parameter updated_since_cursor on GET /v2/issues that accepts an opaque token returned from a previous page or from X-Issues-Cursor on list responses. Server decodes to a (updated_at, issue_id) pair for stable keyset pagination.
Acceptance: cursor is monotonic across concurrent updates; invalid tokens return 400; documentation includes a sample poll loop; works with existing project and label filters.
